shared_elements: offering table or stand with tall vessel
round-topped stela field with figural scene above and text below
figures wearing long garments and wigs
justification: Both are round/pointed-topped stelae showing profile human figures flanking an offering stand with a tall vessel, one figure with arms raised in adoration facing a larger receiving figure, above horizontal registers filled with columns and rows of the same hieroglyphic sign repertoire; both use the same profile-with-frontal-shoulders convention, long kilts/robes and register lines. The difference is mainly in the number and organisation of figures — A crowds several small standing and seated figures into two figural registers with dense signs interleaved, while B has a single clear two-figure encounter above a block of text.
